description: Creates a copy of an existing Salesforce record by reading its data, removing system fields, and creating a new record. Optionally apply field updates to the clone.

field_updates.description: Optional field updates to apply to the cloned record as a JSON string. Use this to modify specific fields in the clone. Example: '{"Name": "Clone of Original", "Status": "New"}'
field_updates.human_parameter_description: Any changes you want to make on the new copy, provided as a JSON string with field names and their new values. Use this to tweak details like Name, Status, or Owner on the cloned record.
field_updates.title: Field Updates

object_type.description: The Salesforce object type to clone (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity).
object_type.human_parameter_description: The kind of Salesforce record you want to copy, like Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity. Choose the object the original record belongs to so we clone the right thing.
object_type.title: Object Type

record_id.description: The ID of the record to clone.
record_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the record you want to clone. You can copy this from the record’s URL or a previous search/list result.
record_id.title: Record Id

name: clone_record

CloneRecordResponse.description: Response from Salesforce record creation/cloning operation.

errors.description: Array of error objects representing the errors associated with a failed record. Empty array when the operation is successful.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The ID of the newly created/cloned record. This field contains a value only if the operation was successful. If this field is empty, the operation was not successful.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful (true) or not (false).
success.title: Success

CloneRecordResponse.title: CloneRecordResponse

SalesforceError.description: Represents an error returned by Salesforce API.

fields.description: Array of field names where the error occurred. Empty array when the error is not associated with a specific field.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
message.title: Message

statusCode.description: The error code identifier (also referred to as 'errorCode' in some contexts). Examples: INVALID_FIELD, MALFORMED_QUERY, INVALID_SESSION_ID, FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION, MALFORMED_ID.
statusCode.title: Status Code

SalesforceError.title: SalesforceError
